claims.claim: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue reached $2.05B, up 34% year over year, while management cited exceptional customer demand and AI datacenter architectures shifting from copper toward optical connectivity.

factors.name: Optical bottleneck exposure
factors.basis: AI datacenter optical transition and expanding production capacity align with Coherent's photonics portfolio.

risks.risk: Capacity expansion ahead of demand realization can pressure returns if AI optical demand normalizes.

causalEdges.mechanism: optics can move high-bandwidth traffic more efficiently as clusters scale
causalEdges.falsifier: copper remains economically dominant longer or Coherent loses share

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration and exact optical content per AI system remain unquantified here.

claims.claim: Q4 GAAP gross margin reached 38.5% and non-GAAP gross margin 40.2%, both materially higher year over year, while non-GAAP EPS rose to $1.74, showing operating leverage alongside revenue growth.

factors.name: Execution quality
factors.basis: Revenue growth coincided with margin expansion and faster EPS growth.

risks.risk: Exceptional demand language raises the comparison and execution bar for fiscal 2027.

causalEdges.mechanism: capacity utilization and richer mix can expand gross margin
causalEdges.falsifier: pricing pressure or ramp costs reverse margin gains

unknowns.unknown: No canonical security-level valuation input is asserted.
